topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I can't believe they used my essay like that. I mean, I submitted it, of course, but I just thought it was for the application. They never said anything about using it as an example. Now everyone's talking about it, and it's everywhere. I didn't even get a heads up. If I had known, I would've double-checked every word, every sentence. It's not that I'm worried about what they think of me, it's just... it feels wrong somehow. Like my private thoughts are now public domain. I wish someone had asked. I should probably reach out to them, right? Just to clarify or maybe ask for it to be taken down. What do you think?
